videos.script: Every dependency of the box office will be down one day. The question is what still works when it is. {{deps}} The replica stops, and reads come from the primary, in the same request. {{replica}} Both databases stop. A show read before comes from memory, six seconds old, and says so. Sales pause before anyone is charged. {{nodb}} And planning the failures found a real defect: a sold-out show charged the buyer. Now it checks first. {{soldout}} Then capacity. Little's law: what is inside equals what arrives times how long it stays. {{little}} A simulated queue shows why nothing should run near a hundred percent: ten milliseconds of work takes a hundred at ninety percent busy. {{curve}} And a plan for an on-sale: six thousand buyers, two CPUs of work, four copies, and a database that only takes a hundred connections. {{plan}}
